snippet.title: Kings Do Not Fall – Demo Now Live on Steam! A retro-inspired beat ’em up fueled by 90s arcade spirit
snippet.description:
When the kingdom needs a legend, you don’t fall...you rise.
In a land torn apart, an entire army has fallen.
Embark on a classic beat ’em up, just like we loved to play in the 90s.

HyperDevbox is thrilled to announce its next nostalgic adventure: Kings Do Not Fall, a retro style beat ’em up that brings the golden age of arcade gaming back into the modern era.
The game will launch in Q1 2026 (exact date TBA) on PC (Steam) and Android (Google Play).

Kings Do Not Fall – Demo Now Live on Steam!
A retro-inspired beat ’em up fueled by 90s arcade spirit ⚔️
Play the first level and fight your way into the Demo TOP30 leaderboard!
 
Kings Do Not Fall Free Demo - on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4231970/Kings_Do_Not_Fall/

If you enjoyed the game, please consider adding it to your Wishlist.
It would truly help us - thank you for your support.

* About Kings Do Not Fall
In an ancient world torn between light and darkness, King Alden - the last ruler of Solara - stands alone against the encroaching forces of Umbra. The story follows his desperate quest to defend his realm from goblins, orcs, and restless dead that swarm across a shattered valley. Players will step into Alden’s boots, battling through six hand crafted levels that culminate in epic boss encounters. With each fight, the stakes rise: every fallen knight fuels Alden’s resolve to “not fall” even when all hope seems lost.

“Fight! Smash! Break through the horde!”

* Key Features
• Retro arcade style Beat ’em Up - Arcade inspired graphics and a CRT mode that lets you crank up the retro fury.
• 6 Levels & Bosses - Journey from the valley of Solara to the heart of Umbra, facing increasingly tough foes.
• Dozens of Enemies - Goblins, orcs, restless dead, and more await in every level.
• Old school Action - Supercharged - Classic side scroller combat with modern polish: combo moves, smash attacks, different weapons and powerful Super-Attacks.

* About the creator
Carlo Perconti, born in 1966, is a veteran game developer. Alongside his longtime collaborator and friend Lyes Belaidouni, he worked as the programmer on games such as Legend and Iron Commando on Super Nintendo, Burning Road on Sony PlayStation, and Soulfighter on Sega Dreamcast, among many others.
Now, more than three decades after his first beat ’em up (Legend), he returns to the roots of the genre. Kings Do Not Fall is a modern yet old-school beat ’em up, a new game that looks and plays like a classic 1990s title, created as a tribute to fans of the genre.  

* About HyperDevbox
Based in Tokyo and founded in 2005 by CEO Carlo Perconti, HyperDevbox is a multi platform developer and publisher dedicated to delivering fun, high quality, and technically advanced games. From retro classics to modern shooters, our titles span PC, smartphones, tablets, and consoles.

Website: 
http://www.hyperdevbox.com

Facebook: 
http://www.facebook.com/hyperdevbox
________________________________________

HyperDevbox - “Bringing back the glory of retro gaming—one beat at a time.”
